summary_1line: Armies gather at Kurukshetra, omens appear, conches sound, and both sides establish formal rules of warfare before the battle begins.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna and Arjuna standing together on a single chariot blow their celestial conches as terrified soldiers tremble beneath a darkened sky.
A black cloud rains flesh and blood over the vast armies of Kurukshetra while dust rises and the sun disappears.
Two immense armies stretching across the plain face each other like twin oceans, banners and elephants filling the horizon.
